name: SameDiffScopeSerdeTest: 6 fixes to go from 16/23 pass to 22/23 pass

fixes.change: eval() returns result.dup() — detached copy survives session destruction
fixes.root_cause: destroySession() closes DataBuffers in nodeOutputs; eval() returned session-managed array

fixes.change: Added PLACEHOLDER handling in output extraction — return caller-supplied placeholder array
fixes.root_cause: DSP never assigns output slots for placeholders (slot -1), so C++ returns nullptr and Java gets FLOAT dummy

fixes.change: Catch Exception instead of IllegalStateException, check message contains 'labels'
fixes.root_cause: DSP throws RuntimeException wrapping the error, not IllegalStateException

fixes.change: Added placeholder shape validation in toPlaceholderMap() using Shape.shapeMatchesPlaceholder()
fixes.root_cause: toPlaceholderMap() put arrays directly into map without shape validation; only setArray() validated

remaining_failures.issue: DSP outputAll() returns wrong intermediate variable values — mmul gets sigmoid output instead of raw matmul

verification.result: 6 test failures/errors fixed, 1 remaining (DSP outputAll intermediate mapping)
